description: Defines the MidiInputPortSelector class which manages MIDI input port selection and handling in an Android application.

classes.name: MidiInputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that manages MIDI input port selection and connection within an Android app.

methods.name: MidiInputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with MIDI manager, activity, and spinner ID.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a MIDI port is selected, opens the device and port.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver associated with the selected input port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the MIDI input port and device, cleaning up resources.
